loading.evidence: Delayed connection/save regression verifies busy state blocks competing actions; existing Connecting status remains visible.

empty.evidence: Fresh disposable profile captured in empty.png; connection guidance visible.

error.evidence: Packaged connection test rejects wrong password and displays inline recovery guidance without losing the active session.

partial.evidence: Unavailable credential-store regression retains connection metadata while explicitly reporting session-only password storage.

success.evidence: connections-dark.png shows successful isolated test; packaged save/restart/edit/delete lifecycle passed.

permission.evidence: Native-store failure simulated in main process; UI reports unavailable storage and session-only fallback. Real locked-Keychain qualification remains untested.
